outcome: severity of urinary symptoms (UDI-6 scores, IIQ-7 scores)
cohort: Women with voiding dysfunction who referred to the pelvic floor disorders clinic of Imam Khomeini Hospital in Tehran between 2018-2020.
finding: Intermittent stream and straining to void were related to stages of prolapse in the apical and anterior regions, and greater prolapse was associated with higher PVR > 100.
